ocrRawText:
Peach Cobbler
1 can peach pie filling
1/4 tsp nutmeg
1 C. Bisquick
1/4 C. milk
1 Tbsp sugar
1" marg. softened
2" slivered nuts
cinnamon
mix pie filling + nutmeg
nuke on 70% - 4 min. Stir.
mix rest of ingredients
drop by spoonfuls onto
hot peach mixture.
nuke - med hi 7 min.
rotate - nuke 2-5 min
Let stand 10 min
